div.p: My notion w'd be for you to put two compositors (among y'r best ones) on this, & set it all up complete ‸pp: 3 to 42 —& let me have the galley proofs complete, (I sh'd say five possibly six galleys)———

The measure is to be exactly the same as in "Nov. Boughs" set up by you ‸the additional pp: are to go in with the other book, bound in it —long primer—asbefore Horace Traubel is to manage &c: the same as myself.

postscript.p: pass this of course to Mr Myrick

div.head: Preface Note to 2d Annex,
concluding L of G—1891
div.p: Had I not better withhold (in this old age and paralysis of me) such little tags and fringe-dots (maybe specks, stains,) as follow a long dusty journey and witness it afterward? I have ‸probably not been ‸enough afraid of such ‸careless touches, from the first, ‸and am not now——nor of parrot-like repetitions,—as I grow older—nor even platitudes and the commonplace. (Perhaps I am too democratic for that ‸such avoidances.) Besides, is not the verse⹀field, as originally plann'd by my theory,
